meta.title: Long-task relay
meta.description: Turn a long task into a session chain: the truth source lives in workspace files, and when context nears its limit the plugin wraps up, opens a fresh session, and hands the work over. The new session keeps the permission preset, goal, and plan mode. Cluster mode plans first, then opens several sessions in parallel once you confirm the grouping. The panel lists what needs a human, shows the relay track, features, and truth source, and can pause, hand off, clear a blocker, or finish a chain.

ui.confirmDelete: Delete this chain? Its features, progress, handoff brief, and audit log are removed too; this cannot be undone.
ui.deleteBlocked: Pause the chain before deleting it
